observations: One physical game case for FIFA 22 is visible in photo 0.
Power and USB cables are present.
A watermark 'CHIBROS MUSICALS POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of photo 0.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the console booting and running a game.
The physical game in photo 0 is FIFA 22, not 24.
FIFA 26 does not exist; the series was renamed to EA Sports FC after FIFA 23.
No physical cases or screen shots of a digital library are shown.

risks.risk: The photo may be stolen or from a different seller (watermarked 'CHIBROS MUSICALS').
risks.proof: A photo of the console next to a handwritten note with the current date and buyer's name.

risks.risk: Console may have a faulty disc drive or be banned from PSN.
risks.proof: Video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and the console connecting to the PlayStation Store.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
Controllers may have 'stick drift' or failing batteries.
risks.proof: Video of the controllers being used to navigate menus without ghost inputs.

proof_requests: A photo of the console and controllers with a handwritten note showing today's date and your name to verify possession.
A photo or video of the 'Settings > Storage' screen to verify capacity.
A photo of the actual game discs or the digital library showing FIFA 24, Ghost of Tsushima, and Spider-Man.
A video of the console booting up and launching a game.
response.reason: The seller claims a non-existent game (FIFA 26) and the photo shows FIFA 22 while the text claims FIFA 24. Additionally, the photo is watermarked by a third-party business, suggesting it may not be the seller's own image.
